title: Would not charge on the docking station-see edited review
text:
Would not charge on the docking station-see edited review. Returned because it would not charge on the docking station and lost its brushes after 10 min use.
Was very quiet

I was contacted by the seller offering a full refund and a promise to have the product reviewed and improved for future buyers. I believe this was an honest appeal and the seller will follow through. Unfortunately, I have already returned the product, but I would be willing to give this seller another chance in the future given those facts.
It had great suction and was very quiet when running.

product_metadata.title: Holove Robot Vacuum Cleaner and Dry Mopping Sweeper, Slim D2 WiFi 1800PA Strong Suction with Automatic Self-Charging, Robotic Vacuum Cleaner for Pet Hair, Hard Floor and Low Pile Carpet
features: 【SMART BROOMOP】 Household Intelligent IC chipset robot vacuum cleaner with multi modes setting can do auto , spot ,edge and schedule cleaning, also with 15° climbing capability,vacuum cleaner can fully fulfil different family demands for deep Cleaner.

【 3 In 1 VACUUM & SWEEP & MOP】1800pa highly suction ability smart robot vacuum cleaner automatic vacuuming, sweeping and dry mopping. The large 600ml dust bin with special design flat nozzle can 99% cleaning micro dirt, hairs, grains and particles. Vacuum multi-surfaces and mop hard-floors for a deeper clean that will leave your floors sparkling!

【INTELLIGENT PROTECTION】Automatic vacuum cleaner robot with genius gyro routing to provide efficiency cleaning coverage.Using upgraded anti-collision & drop- Smart sensation technology for enhanced navigation and evading obstacles, to protect the robot from scratches and avoid falling & bumping .

【SUPER BATTERY POWER & AUTOMATIC】High capacity 4400mAh battery, Offering long lasting cruising up to 90- 120 minutes, easily for big space cleaning requirement. Holove D2 rechargeable robot vacuum cleaner IR charging sensor can defect up to 8 meters from charging docking, Automatically go back to recharge when power is lower than 20 percent, after being fully recharged, auto continuing the unfinished cleaning task.

【VOICE & APP CONTROLS】 Connect to the 2.4GHZ WIFI Network, Smart vacuum cleaner use the Amazon Alexa and the Google Assistant voice commands to conveniently start and stop cleaning. Using the smart App to control robot vacuum cleaner, monitor real-time cleaning/battery power/accessories status, customize cleaning modes/mopping levels/schedule cleaning, control cleaning direction, finds your robot effortlessly.
